pages.title: A car for one week · 1/3
paragraphs: Julia lands at the Miami airport on a hot Monday. She needs a car for one week. The rental lot has a convertible, an SUV and many small cars. She prefers a hybrid because it saves gas. A rental agent named Carl stands at the desk. He has a friendly voice and a big folder.
“Good afternoon! Can I help you?” says Carl. “Yes. I would like to rent a hybrid car.” says Julia. “Sure. We have a hybrid sedan for forty dollars a day.” says Carl.
